subject: Coordination: CodeCraft joint webinar + conference booth (June/Sept)

Subject: Joint webinar + booth opportunity at DataStack West

Hey Ben —

Quick intro: I run partnerships at CodeCraft (we're an ISV that provides vector search tooling for LLM apps). We spoke briefly at the partner lunch last month and Samir from CloudForge suggested we loop you in about a joint program idea.

High-level: CodeCraft would like to co-host a 45-minute technical webinar in late August (target audience: infra/ML platform engineers) and then do a co-branded booth at DataStack West (Sept 22-24). We think Redwood's inference runtime would be a perfect fit for a joint demo showing how CodeCraft indexing + Redwood serving reduces latency and cost for retrieval-augmented generation.

Ask: are you open to a short sync next week to sketch scope, roles, and rough promo timeline? If yes, what days work for you?

Attachments: none in this message.

—Nina

- Conference booth: we need to confirm headcount and budget, but preliminarily yes — we often do co-badged booths with partners.

Can we do a 30-min sync Wed 24th at 11am PT? I'll include Marissa (demand gen) and Karthik (partner engineering) to scope content and handoff.

Two initial asks for the call:
1) A 1-pager with target audience and demo flow (what CodeCraft will demo),
2) Any brand guidelines you need from Redwood.

I'll prep a short playbook draft for responsibilities.

Thanks — speaking soon.

Subject: Notes from sync — high-level plan (webinar + DataStack booth)

Hi Nina / CodeCraft team — thanks for the sync today. Recap notes and agreements below (let me know if I missed anything).

1) Webinar (target week Aug 24-28):
- Format: 45-min technical demo + 15-min live Q&A. Two speakers (CodeCraft engineer + Redwood engineer). Recorded for on-demand.
- Topics: indexing strategy, retrieval latency tradeoffs, integrating CodeCraft SDK with Redwood runtime, live perf comparison (cold vs warmed cache).
- Registration: Redwood landing page (HubSpot). We will set up joint registration and capture lead ownership field.
- Promo: joint email (Redwood lists) + partner push; paid social spend split 60/40 (Redwood/CodeCraft).

2) DataStack West booth (Sept 22-24):
- Booth: co-branded 10x20 with joint demo station. Redwood to cover lead capture hardware and staffing for one full-time Redwood engineer on demo shifts. CodeCraft to provide demo laptop + collateral.
- Logistics: both teams to share shipping address for booth materials; early setup day Sept 21.

3) Lead handling: use the attached Lead_HandOff_Template.csv. Both sides agreed 24-48h SLA for lead follow-up; Redwood to push leads into HubSpot and share weekly CSV export to CodeCraft.

4) Next steps (owners):
- CodeCraft: 1-pager (audience + demo flow) by Fri 6/26 (Nina).
- Redwood: draft landing page + promo calendar by Mon 6/29 (Marissa).
- Engineering: demo runbook + test dataset by Mon 7/6 (Karthik).

Attachments: CodeCraft_Redwood_joint_webinar_brief_v1.pdf (partner brief), Lead_HandOff_Template.csv (lead mapping).

Ben
Senior Partner Sales
